channel.title: Crypto Bulletin
channel.description: Crypto Bulletin reports crypto news on bitcoin, ethereum, stablecoins, exchanges, DeFi protocols, regulation, security incidents and market structure.

item.title: Coinbase and Marqeta plan stablecoin-backed cards for businesses
item.description: Coinbase will handle custody, fiat conversion and settlement on Base for cards Marqeta customers can issue, letting users spend stablecoin balances at global merchants.

item.title: What a token approval does before a bridge
item.description: A token approval lets a bridge contract move specified tokens from your wallet; check the spender, cap and network before signing, then review unused access.

item.title: Cross-chain swaps trade speed against settlement certainty
item.description: A cross-chain swap balances confirmation time against settlement certainty: check source-chain confirmations, output asset, fees and slippage before choosing speed.

item.title: Choose a destination wallet before your first cross-chain swap
item.description: Before a first cross-chain swap, match the destination wallet to the receiving network, asset and recovery method to reduce failed transfers and confusion.

item.title: Four checks for accurate cross-chain portfolio tracking
item.description: Cross-chain portfolio tracking depends on matching balances by network, reconciling bridge transfers and pricing wrapped tokens consistently across chains.

item.title: Stalled Bridge Transactions: How Nonce Management Works
item.description: A stalled bridge transfer may be waiting on a source-chain nonce or a separate destination step; identify which one before replacing or cancelling anything.

item.title: How to Pay Contributor Invoices Through a Mantle Bridge
item.description: Paying a contributor on Mantle takes two transactions when funds start elsewhere: bridge the agreed token, then send it to the invoice wallet and log both hashes.

item.title: Coinbase and Marqeta expand partnership for stablecoin cards
item.description: Marqeta and Coinbase expanded their partnership Oct. 16, enabling businesses to issue stablecoin-backed cards with Coinbase custody and conversion and settlement on Base.

item.title: How to Move Bitcoin Cash Into Ethereum Lending
item.description: Bitcoin Cash cannot enter an Ethereum lending market directly: users need a supported Ethereum token, then must weigh bridge, custody and liquidation risks.

item.title: How to use different wallets with a Mantle bridge
item.description: You can bridge assets between wallets on Mantle, but the source, recipient, network and gas balance must line up before you approve a transfer.

item.title: Network School acquires Farcaster and adds user contract
item.description: Network School acquired Farcaster from Neynar and is asking users to accept an onchain conduct agreement for full access, shifting how the platform is governed.

item.title: Native or Wrapped Gas Tokens: Which Should You Choose?
item.description: Choose the native gas token for network fees and the wrapped version when an app needs a transferable token; check chain, contract and liquidity before swapping.

item.title: What to Check in Bitcoin Threshold Signing
item.description: Threshold signing lets Bitcoin key holders approve a release without putting the full key in one place; assess quorum, signer independence, recovery and transaction checks.

item.title: Choose native or wrapped bitcoin by destination and exit route
item.description: Choose native BTC when you need Bitcoin-chain control; use wrapped BTC only when the destination app accepts that token and its redemption route fits before sending.

item.title: Five Address-Book Checks Before a Cross-Chain Transfer
item.description: Five checks—network, full address, checksum, memo or tag, and a small test transfer—help catch cross-chain address-book mistakes before funds move.

item.title: Founders Fund leads $5M purchase of Anvil governance tokens
item.description: Founders Fund led a $5 million purchase of Anvil’s ANVL governance tokens, joined by Pantera and others, giving buyers a role in protocol decisions.

item.title: THORChain’s Outbound Multiplier Changes Swap Payouts
item.description: THORChain’s outbound fee multiplier scales destination-chain gas, shifts with fee surplus and reduces the asset delivered; check the route fee before swapping.

item.title: How to Pay Mantle Lending Interest From Another Chain
item.description: To pay Mantle lending interest from another chain, bridge the borrowed asset to Mantle, then approve and repay it through the market holding the debt.

item.title: Mantle bridge swaps have no fixed slippage limit
item.description: A Mantle bridge transfer can preserve the same token amount, but a route that swaps assets can deliver less as prices move or pool liquidity thins.

item.title: Rebasing changes bridge amounts as token balances update
item.description: A rebase changes a token balance without a transfer, so bridges can misstate what arrives; share-based or wrapped tokens keep amounts predictable across chains.
